3.task: Discover local state and journal contract requirements
acceptance_basis: mission-checklist.json, ordinal 3; reconstructed-label provenance explicitly retained
retained_evidence: Domain contracts define entries, attempts, comments, saved routes, likes, following, and activity state. Validation specifies known routes, real calendar dates, integer attempts 1–100, and bounded conditions/notes.
Storage code separates ready/error state from safe hydration and corruption state, with a single persist-before-memory mutation boundary.

35.task: Implement deterministic atomic local journal persistence and validation store in lib/boarded/journal.ts and lib/boarded/store.ts
retained_evidence: Every state-changing journal mutation routes through applyUpdate, which rejects unread/corrupted storage, writes the full next snapshot synchronously, and commits memory only after successful persistence.
Initialization and Retry validate before loading; neither silently overwrites malformed storage nor queues/replays failed mutations.

Form submission consumes the returned id only on success; comment drafts clear only on success; deletion/Undo and mark-sent consumers retain error recovery. Non-form toggles remain backed by store state and the shared Shell storage alert.

42.task: Automated unit and integration test suite pass
retained_evidence: integration-verification.json records node --test lib/boarded/*.test.ts lib/utils/*.test.ts packages/shared/utils/*.test.ts in the primary checkout: exit 0, 46 tests passed, 12 suites, 0 failures; reviewed HEAD/diff and 20/20 candidate-file parity are recorded.

Read the complete journal test file. Its observable defenses include invalid dates/types/ranges, sent-before-published, idempotent transitions/restoration, retained durable bytes on corruption, denied-getter recovery with existing data, and exactly-one attempt/comment after failed write → Retry → explicit resubmission.
Failure updates only error state; entries/comments/deletion remain unchanged until setItem succeeds. Retry re-reads durable state without replaying the rejected operation.
Tests assert repeated markSent/publish/restore do not duplicate entries, and failed attempt/comment writes followed by Retry and explicit resubmission produce exactly one durable addition.

form-validation-storage-recovery.json retains the failed draft and original count 1, then shows exactly one additional recovered attempt; comment-storage-recovery.json records failed addition count 0 and recovered addition count 1.
Raw malformed JSON remains exactly '{broken journal' before and after Retry in the browser evidence, with visible recovery alerts.

Strict hydration rejects malformed entry schemas, unsafe ids, unknown routes, invalid dates/counts/text, nonboolean publication, and published-unsent entries rather than coercing or truncating user data.

Retained passing tests demonstrate denied initial localStorage getter does not overwrite preexisting journal data; restoring access and Retry recovers the original entry and saved route without changing the raw stored bytes.

55.task: Atomic deletion rollback and inline Undo recovery on failed storage writes
retained_evidence: Failed delete cannot remove the in-memory entry because persistence precedes commit. The UI keeps the confirmation dialog and earlier Undo target on failure; successful deletion alone replaces that target.
Undo uses the same atomic persistence boundary; its failure branch retains lastDeletedEntry and the actionable Undo banner instead of falsely claiming restoration.

Browser audit records count 1 after successful first deletion, count 1 plus an open dialog and explicit error after blocked second deletion, preserved earlier Undo text, then restoration of review-sent and review-attempt with focus on delete-entry-review-sent.

Attempt validation rejects invalid route/date/count/text inputs, focuses the error summary, and preserves values on validation or persistence failure. Recovered submission navigates using the successfully persisted entry id.
Form browser evidence records invalid-attempt aria-invalid=true, focused error summary, unchanged notes 'Preserve <this> & retry.', and a single recovered addition.
Comment evidence records preserved failed draft 'Atomic comment recovery', no failed addition, then cleared draft and one successful addition.
Caption evidence records a 400-character value rejected with published=false and a visible length error, followed by successful publication of 'Quiet feet & patient hands — sent! 🧗'.

findings.title: Preserve native tab order when focusing hash targets
findings.body: The Log form's error summary links to native controls such as #log-date and #log-attempts. Activating one runs this hashchange handler, which permanently sets the input's tabindex to -1 for the mounted form. The field receives focus initially but is subsequently skipped by Tab and Shift+Tab, including after its error-summary link disappears on correction. The route-effect hash path at Shell.tsx:249 has the same behavior. Add tabindex only when the target needs programmatic focus, preserving existing native/explicit sequential focusability; retain the current section-target behavior for #comments and #share.
findings.evidence: LogFlow.tsx error-summary anchors target log-route/log-date/log-attempts/log-conditions/log-notes; corresponding select/input/textarea controls are initially natively tabbable. Shell.tsx:249 and :371 mutate every resolved hash target without testing focusability. Retained history audits exercise section targets only.
findings.targeted_validation: On /app/log, invalidate date and attempts, submit, activate the date error-summary link, correct date, then Tab to attempts and Shift+Tab. Inspect log-date.tabIndex and observe whether date is skipped. Main has been notified and owns any reproduction/fix.

findings.title: Preserve intentionally empty captions in send and export consumers
findings.body: Publishing an empty caption is supported and ShareFlow explicitly preserves that value when reopening a published entry, but SendDetail replaces it with entry.notes here. Thus clearing and publishing the caption still exposes the session notes as the send report's caption. The SVG consumer likewise replaces an empty caption with 'Clean send on the project!' at LogFlow.tsx:693, although the live preview shows no quote. Consume the saved/edited caption without truthiness fallbacks in both places so intentionally blank content remains blank.
findings.evidence: store.ts publish accepts and persists ''; LogFlow.tsx:480,490 deliberately hydrate published empty captions; Details.tsx:303 falls back to notes and :463-465 renders the resulting quote; LogFlow.tsx:693 injects the default into svgCardContent while the HTML preview is conditional on caption. atomic-flow-final.patch explicitly removed the same truthiness fallback from caption initialization/hydration. unicode-empty-caption-audit.json retains caption='' and a disabled Published to Journal button, but does not assert the send report or exported caption.
findings.targeted_validation: Use one sent entry with nonempty notes, publish an empty caption, inspect /app/send/id and decode its Share page SVG download. Neither should synthesize a caption absent from the live preview/saved caption. Coordinated with domain reviewer, who retains passing domain persistence acceptance rather than duplicating this consumer finding.

findings.title: Label the manual-copy fallback input
findings.body: When clipboard access is unavailable or denied, ShareFlow renders this read-only input without a label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or associated identifier. A screen-reader user reaches an unnamed textbox precisely in the recovery path needed to copy the send URL. Add an associated visible label and identifier, following the existing labeled manual-copy input in SendDetail, so the fallback remains understandable without visual context.
findings.evidence: handleCopyLink catches unavailable/rejected navigator.clipboard.writeText and sets manualCopyUrl; this conditional is its rendering consumer. Details.tsx:532-550 already implements the comparable fallback with a b-field and label htmlFor=manual-copy-input. Retained default share-screen audits do not exercise this conditional input.
findings.targeted_validation: Deny clipboard.writeText on a populated /app/share/id page, activate Copy Direct Send URL, and inspect the resulting textbox's accessibility name. Only this fallback needs checking, not the previously passing screen matrix.
